# M. Reno Hidayat — Full Stack Engineer Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of M. Reno Hidayat, S.Kom. — Full Stack Engineer and Informatics graduate from Universitas Sebelas April, Indonesia. This website showcases interactive 3D web design, production-grade projects, scientific research, and professional certifications.

## About This Website

This is an interactive portfolio website built with React, TypeScript, Three.js, and Framer Motion, deployed on Firebase Hosting. It features a 3D interactive hero section, smooth scroll animations, custom cursor effects, bilingual support (Indonesian/English), and responsive design for all devices. The website demonstrates advanced frontend engineering capabilities including WebGL rendering, GSAP animations, and modern component architecture.

URL: https://renohidayat.my.id/

## About M. Reno Hidayat

M. Reno Hidayat is a Full Stack Engineer based in Indonesia, specializing in web development, mobile development (Flutter), backend systems (Laravel, Node.js, FastAPI), and machine learning. He graduated with a Bachelor of Computer Science (S.Kom.) from Universitas Sebelas April (UNSAP) in Informatics Engineering. He has 4+ years of learning experience, 7+ built projects, and 15+ official certifications.

## Selected Projects

### 1. SIPENA — Sistem Informasi Ujian & Absensi (2026)
Multi-platform digital examination & attendance system (pre-deployment) built in technical coordination with FEB UNSAP IT staff. Features Android Flutter app, iOS PWA, React Web Admin, 10-second heartbeat live monitoring, background anti-cheat detection, automated PDF attendance reports, and batch push notifications via Firebase Cloud Messaging.
Tech: Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Node.js, React PWA
Link: https://github.com/Renohidayat/feb-unsap-exam

### 2. Website FEB UNSAP — Official Faculty Portal (2025-2026)
Official web portal and academic CMS for the Faculty of Economics & Business, Universitas Sebelas April serving 3 study programs, 1,500+ students, 45+ lecturers, and 5,000+ alumni. Engineered with Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, MySQL, and Tailwind CSS across 30 Eloquent models, 59 migrations, 64 controllers (23 Admin CMS modules), and 201 Blade views—featuring digital student letter submission with DOCX export (PHPWord), bulk Excel imports, Google OAuth, Multi-Role RBAC, and CSP security, supporting institutional governance transparency during S1 Management's LAMEMBA "Unggul" accreditation (Nov 2026).
Tech: Laravel 12, PHP 8.2, MySQL, Tailwind CSS, Vite
Link: https://feb.unsap.ac.id/

### 3. Jelajah Nusantara AI — AI Travel Planner (2026)
AI-powered travel itinerary planning platform for destinations across Indonesia. Features smart daily schedules generated by DeepSeek AI, interactive maps via Leaflet.js, visual budget tracking with Chart.js, and real-time Firebase backend in a Vercel Serverless monorepo architecture.
Tech: JavaScript, Vite, Node.js, Express, Firebase, DeepSeek AI
Link: https://jelajah-nusantara-ai.vercel.app/

### 4. Sentiment Analysis — Machine Learning Research (2026)
NLP research analyzing public sentiment from 2,561 YouTube comments across 11 viral videos. Uses SVM-RBF classifier with PySastrawi stemmer achieving 75.24% accuracy, 73.46% F1-score, and Fleiss' Kappa 0.8635. Deployed with FastAPI backend and interactive React dashboard.
Tech: Python, Scikit-learn, FastAPI, React, Vite
Link: https://sentimen-ijazah.vercel.app/

### 5. CGMI Assessment App — Civic GovTech (2026)
Single Page Application for measuring Collaboration Governance Maturity Index across local government agencies in Sumedang Regency. Evaluates 30 questions across 6 dimensions with automated scoring into 5 maturity levels, Radar Chart visualization, and hybrid Firebase authentication.
Tech: JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Firebase, Chart.js, HTML5
Link: https://cgmi-assessmentt.web.app/

### 6. NimeXx — Mobile Streaming App (2025)
Cross-platform mobile anime streaming app built with Flutter and Dart. Features clean UI, search discovery, custom video player, and Firebase cloud synchronization.
Tech: Flutter, Dart, Firebase
Link: https://apkpure.com/id/nimexx/com.rennv.nimexxv2

### 7. Dapoer Sari Pohaci — MSME Digitization (2026)
Digital storefront web app empowering a local traditional food business in Serang Village, built during university community service (KKN). Features product catalog and direct WhatsApp ordering.
Tech: Tailwind CSS, JavaScript, Firebase
Link: https://dapoer-saripohaci.web.app/
